title: Signal restricts iOS and Android AI assistants from reading chats
date_note: Signal's own blog post is dated 20 November 2026.
geo_basis: organisation-wide announcement; pin is a nominal location for Signal, not stated in the sources
summary: Signal says in a blog post that it is restricting AI agents built into mobile operating systems from capturing its chats. On iOS 27 it blocks in-app screenshots, which users can turn off; on Android it enables Screen security when it detects an AI assistant reading the screen, though Signal says coverage is incomplete. Signal asks Apple, Google and Microsoft to document AI data access and let developers opt out.
plain: Signal says it is blocking screenshots on iOS 27 and turning on Screen security on Android so phone AI assistants cannot read its chats, and says coverage is incomplete.
exec: Signal says OS-level AI assistants can read chat content on screen; its protections are partial, per its own post.
action: Signal advises, for macOS, adding Signal to the Excluded Apps list in System Settings > Siri; BleepingComputer adds that iOS users should update Signal and check App Security.

validation.note: Signal's own post read (primary); BleepingComputer and Dataconomy relay it.
